name: ZCA_BI_CRM_CAL_QUARTER
description: This table stores Gregorian and Accounting Calendar information at Quarter level.

columns.name: FISCAL_PERIOD_TYPE
columns.description: Accounting period type. Examples are Weekly, Monthly, Quarterly.

columns.name: FISCAL_YEAR_NUMBER
columns.description: Denotes the accounting calendar year represented by a numerical value, such as 2009.

columns.name: FISCAL_QUARTER_START_DATE
columns.description: Date when the quarter containing this accounting period starts.

columns.name: FISCAL_QUARTER_END_DATE
columns.description: Date when the quarter containing this accounting period ends.

columns.name: FISCAL_YEAR_START_DATE
columns.description: Date when the year containing this accounting period starts.

columns.name: FISCAL_YEAR_END_DATE
columns.description: Date when the year containing this accounting period ends.

columns.name: ENTERPRISE_QUARTER
columns.description: It is a concatenation of Fiscal Year Number  and 'Q' and Fiscal Quarter Number.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.
